answer: Sybil resistance here is priced, not proved. Each new identity needs an established member to vouch for it, and that voucher must stake collateral capped by how many newcomers it may back. A cheap fingerprint layer clusters the vouched identities: shared network signal, timing cadence, and the pigment of behavioral traces like phrasing habits. When two separate identities converge on those markers, the voucher's stake is slashed. To forge a convincing crowd, an attacker must line up many independent vouchers with real value at risk, paying more than a fake swarm could ever farm.
